items.t: Beachgoers in Martin County urged to stay out of water after high levels of fecal bacteria found: Officials
items.x: Water samples taken Monday showed unsafe levels of fecal bacteria at 10 locations, including Bathtub Beach and Jensen Beach. Officials say exposure could raise the risk of illness.

items.t: Martin County man sentenced to 84 years in child pornography, voyeurism case
items.x: Daniel Clark Warren was sentenced to about 84 years in prison after being found guilty on 82 counts, including child pornography and video voyeurism.

items.t: Martin County man charged with attempted murder after roommate slashed in neck with box cutter
items.x: A 32-year-old man is facing an attempted murder charge after deputies say a dispute between roommates ended with a man being slashed in the neck with a box cutter.

items.t: Man accused of slashing acquaintance's neck with box cutter in Martin County
items.x: The Martin County Sheriff's Office have identified the suspect accused of stabbing his acquaintance with a box cutter on Thursday night.

items.t: Martin County deputies probe roommate dispute ending in stabbing on SE Indian Street

items.t: West Palm Beach entrepreneur brings Vietnamese coffee and culture to the GreenMarket
items.x: The West Palm Beach GreenMarket is more than a weekend destination. For local entrepreneurs, it can also be a launching pad for growing a small business.

items.t: A third weekend of protests in France as youth-led rallies sweep Europe
items.x: Thousands of young protesters have taken to the streets across France for a third weekend, protesting over living costs and education.

items.t: In-person early voting hits record pace for midterms
items.x: A record 51.3 million ballots have been cast ahead of Election Day, continuing the growing trend of Americans voting early.

items.t: Houdini's centennial spotlight: A newly published essay and a fresh fight over when and how he died
items.x: Harry Houdini died 100 years ago. Now, a rare essay by the escape artist has been published for the first time, shedding light on his early influences.

items.t: Cast out from their cruise-ship home, couple not ready to come back to South Florida
items.x: They sold their belongings to live at sea. Now, after 18 months and 30 countries, one South Florida couple's cruise ship dream has run aground in Cambodia.

items.t: Wellington flag football coach arrested, accused of choking opposing player
items.x: Brandon Mayer is charged with felony battery, accused of choking a teenage girl during a fight after a flag football game

items.t: Car found in Delray Beach pond; 1 person taken to hospital, arrested
items.x: Crews raced to a Delray Beach pond early Saturday after a car was discovered in the water. One person was taken to the hospital after saying as many as six may have been inside.

items.t: French protesters defy heavy police presence in new demonstrations
items.x: France deployed 70,000 police as hundreds of thousands joined nationwide protests, with tensions escalating into clashes in Paris by nightfall.

items.t: Yelling, a loud bang, then police enter Delray Beach apartment
items.x: Delray Beach police say a late-night apartment disturbance turned violent, leaving a woman injured and an officer with a scratch and knee injury.

items.t: Contractor wants out of Boynton Beach project, says city owes over $300K
items.x: A construction company is suing the City of Boynton Beach, alleging faulty plans and an unpaid change order stalled a $798,225 boat ramp project.

items.t: Lake Worth Beach Commissioner Sarah Malega resigns
items.x: to become executive director of Palm Beach County League of Cities.

items.t: NASA satellite to plunge back to Earth after 22 years in space
items.x: The Swift Observatory's mission is over after 22 years in orbit. NASA expects the satellite to re-enter Earth's atmosphere soon.

items.t: Americans are getting poorer despite bigger paychecks, goverment data shows
items.x: Workers are earning more, but inflation is rising even faster. New government data shows Americans' real income is declining.

items.t: Boynton Beach felon sentenced to 11 years after setting drug-filled car on fire in Lake Worth Beach
